parts.name: 7 Hole - 90 Degree Angled Squared Flat Plate
parts.description: A clear anodized 6063-T6 aluminum 7 hole, 90 degree angled squared flat plate for 15 series T-slot profiles. It mounts to the T-slot with 7 suggested 5/16-18 x 11/16” FBHSCS and Economy T-nut sets, needs no machining, and can be pre-loaded to simplify assembly; it can also mount to Ready Tube.
parts.dimension_notes: A = overall height, B = overall width, C = hole spacing (typ), D = edge to hole center (typ), E = hole diameter (typ), F = plate thickness, G = height of the short right-side edge, H = width of the top edge before the angled cut
parts.notes: Mount to T-Slot uses 7 suggested bolt and T-nut sets. Suggested Hardware (Mount to Ready Tube): 3960 (RT), qty 7, 5/16-18 x 2.00” Flange Hex Head Bolt w/ Flanged Hex Nut.
